items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1995-11-14
items.q: Yeah, for a while, yeah. I went to Europe with him.

ctx.x: What was he? He played more of swing. So did you, oh you also played with somebody we haven't talked about, you were in Fats Domino's band.

Yeah, for a while, yeah. I went to Europe with him. And before you went to Europe I played with the band and then something happened that made me quit, quitting the band. Well see what happened, we were supposed to play this club, I think it was in Canada. We were supposed to play this club and we were supposed to play a certain, a few hours, then take a break. So I forgot just how that thing happened, but I know when it was time for us to get off, they requested that we play a couple of more songs. So the guys…
Oh, so you'd have to go through the union to get fired? Yeah. Fined.
